verdict.rationale: Reclaim publishes a 'How Reclaim's pricing and plans work' help article that defines tiers, but the only tier detailed in the evidence is Lite, free for a single user with 'essential smart time blocking features.' A community user mentions paying about $100/year, which hints at self-serve paid pricing without confirming per-seat figures or tier contents. missing for 10: published per-seat prices for paid tiers, a tier-by-tier feature breakdown, confirmation that pricing is visible without contacting sales, independent corroboration of the pricing page.
